# Halftone Wipe

**Wipe › Pattern** · v1.0.0 · 36 frames at 30 fps (16–72)

A wave of dots grows across the frame, from tiny to touching, with the new scene inside them.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/halftone-wipe@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Print, comic and pop-art looks
- Graphic reveals
- Editorial content

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import halftoneWipe from './transitions/03-wipe/pattern/halftone-wipe';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(halftoneWipe, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 36 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | integer | `28` | 8–60 | Dots across the frame. |
| `angle` | number | `30` | 0–360 | Direction the wave travels, in degrees. |
